title: Matching Decoder Prototype
input: BT1884 detector-time graph for the [[66,13,3]]_3 parent code
scope: one persistent data event plus one transient measurement event over a 3-round window

prototype_rules.persistent_pair: two equal adjacent nonzero syndrome changes choose the BT1878 data link
prototype_rules.data_plus_measurement: choose one data link plus one time link if the supports are disjoint
prototype_rules.relation_shadow: assign high penalty and flag instead of correcting

toy_cases.case: single persistent data syndrome plus isolated time blip
toy_cases.decision: one data correction and one measurement flag

toy_cases.case: two adjacent same-check detector events only

boundary: Finite prototype rule table only; not an optimized MWPM implementation or calibrated detector likelihood model.
